THE WEDSPARKS GUIDE

Planning Your Invitations and RSVP Timing

A useful RSVP date is one that gives you enough time to prepare the next decisions.

Start your wedding planExplore suppliers

By WedSparks · Wedding planning guide

01

Work backwards from your suppliers

Ask your venue and caterer when they need final numbers and dietary requirements. Leave time before that deadline to follow up guests and make any seating decisions.

02

Consider how far guests are travelling

Guests arranging travel, time off or accommodation may need earlier notice. A save-the-date can share the essentials while your invitation details are still taking shape.

03

Make the invitation clear

Include the date, place, start time, reply instructions and the information guests need to plan their attendance. Make it clear who is invited and who can reply for a group.

04

Keep one source for replies

Collect attendance and dietary details in a consistent place. Note when an invitation has been sent, then follow up outstanding replies kindly before your final numbers are due.

05

Check privacy before sharing

Send individual invitation links to their intended recipients. Do not post a link publicly if it exposes personal event or guest information.
